family: Order-flow ideas from Tom extracts on BTC
title: BTC thin-zone pass-through (5m) and accepted-breakdown retest (1h): frozen rules, fee-net, DEV

what.name: Idea source
what.value_plain: Tom extracts extract_BB3c8visnkI idea 3 and extract_e83njGZFrPw idea 1 (idea only, every number is ours)
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: T1 rule
what.value_plain: prior 7 UTC days profile, 0.05% buckets; 5m close enters a bucket under 25% of POC from a non-thin one; trade in that direction; target next bucket over 75% of POC; stop one bucket back; exit 24 5m bars
what.label: OURS

what.name: T2 rule
what.value_plain: 1h; prior 24-bar range under 2.5% wide; close beyond range on 2x median volume, 2 more closes beyond, retest within 24 bars; stop 0.2% past the extreme, target the extreme, exit 48 bars; both sides
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 10 bp round trip (taker, repo fee), entry at the next 1m open, no slippage
what.label: SOURCED

how: 1m BTCUSDT klines, fill walk per 1m bar with stop before target; one position at a time; direction-matched placebo with the real trade geometry at random same-hour times, 1000 draws.
window: DEV 2022-02-01 to 2024-05-31 only; VALIDATION never opened

verdict.label: Both FAIL on DEV: no fee-net edge

why: T1 has about zero gross move (+0.29 bp) so the fee makes it -9.7 bp per trade; 87% of trades hit the one-bucket stop.
T2 is +3.7 bp with t 0.35; the second DEV half is -0.2 bp, and the result sits inside the placebo band.
About 102 tries on this family so far; neither rule clears even the lenient t >= 2 bar.
